title: Wear app: BG arrow not visible on Watch Face AAPS(DigitalStyle)
symptom: On the Wear app watch face AAPS(DigitalStyle), the BG complication does not show the direction arrow, whereas it was visible in the original WatchFace view from version 3.0.0.1 release.
fix: The issue was fixed in a later build; the user confirmed it is fixed for them on AAPS(DigitalStyle).
